elements_selected.content: Implement `zetl reason export` per CON-018. Export the combined theory in two formats: 1) SPL format — reconstructed SPL with provenance comments ('; --- From: file:line ---' before each rule/fact), valid parseable SPL; 2) JSON format — structured { rules[], facts[], superiority[], conclusions[] } with provenance fields on each item. Option: --with-conclusions includes reasoning results in the export. Always exits 0.
